title: GDD's Theme GUI Pack
description: A GUI resource pack based on the Game Development Department(GDD) in the game BlueArchive
body:
This is a GUI customization resource pack which based on the Game Development Department(GDD) in the game BlueArchive from Nexon Game.

The design features its classic blue-and-white color scheme, capturing the retro aesthetic of the Game Development Department!
# Compatible Mods
It is currently compatible with the following popular mods:

[Just Enough Items (JEI)](https://modrinth.com/project/u6dRKJwZ)

[Just Enough Resources (JER)](https://modrinth.com/project/uEfK2CXF)

[Curios API](https://modrinth.com/project/vvuO3ImH)

[Sophisticated Backpacks](https://modrinth.com/project/TyCTlI4b)

[Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/project/R2OftAxM)

[Touhou Little Maid](https://modrinth.com/project/R0bDWFAW)

[Refined Storage(before 1.21.x)](https://modrinth.com/project/KDvYkUg3)

# Credits
The color scheme and design elements used in this resource are inspired by the game BlueArchive from Nexon Game.

The game's main menu features artwork by artist SAIPACo.from pixiv.
